questions.text: What is the purpose of an exclusion zone during struck-by hazard work?

answers.text: To keep unauthorized or unprotected workers out of the hazard area
To replace the need for communication
To allow materials to be dropped without control
To mark where workers should gather during lifts

explanations.a: Exclusion zones separate workers from moving equipment, falling objects, and suspended loads. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: Communication is still needed to maintain the zone.
explanations.c: Dropped materials still require control and worker protection.
explanations.d: Workers should not gather inside struck-by hazard zones.
